verdict.rationale: Asana's App Directory documents one-way and two-way sync that pulls work from other PM and issue tools into Asana, including the Asana for Jira Cloud Data Sync integration and syncs with Jira, Azure DevOps, monday.com, Wrike, GitLab and Bitbucket (including assignees). That implies synced items could appear alongside native Asana tasks. However, the evidence never describes a unified 'my assigned tasks across tools' view, and several connectors appear to be marketplace apps rather than core Asana features. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented unified view of assigned tasks across tools, clear first-party ownership of the multi-tool sync, and hands-on corroboration that synced assignments surface in a personal task list.
